description: The extended edition of The Fellowship of the Ring recut into four sequential chapters, carrying the story from Bilbo's farewell in the Shire through the breaking of the Fellowship.

s01e01.description: Bilbo's long-planned birthday celebration draws Gandalf back to the Shire, where the wizard's suspicions about Bilbo's ring grow into a far darker discovery. Frodo inherits both the Ring and the danger attached to it, turning quiet Hobbit life into the beginning of a journey beyond the Shire.

s01e02.description: Frodo and his companions push farther from home under pursuit, find an unlikely guide in Aragorn and reach the refuge where the Ring's history and fate can finally be confronted. A fellowship is formed around the task of taking it toward Mordor.

s01e03.description: The Fellowship's route south is forced underground into the abandoned Dwarven realm of Moria. What begins as a dangerous passage through ruins becomes a fight through darkness, ancient halls and enemies that reveal how costly the road to Mordor will be.

s01e04.description: After the loss in Moria, the Fellowship regroups and continues down the Anduin while the Ring's influence works on those sworn to protect its bearer. At Amon Hen, pursuit and mistrust fracture the company, leaving Frodo to decide who can still share his burden.
